scope: Indirect comparison of belimumab and anifrolumab from randomised trials in SLE and lupus nephritis.

keyRecommendations.text: Belimumab is described as approved for SLE and lupus nephritis; anifrolumab is not described as approved for lupus nephritis.
Belimumab had a higher SRI-4 odds ratio versus anifrolumab in the indirect comparison (OR 1.99, 95% CI 1.25–3.16).
Anifrolumab was favoured for steroid tapering (OR 0.31, 95% CI 0.19–0.51) and was linked to more herpes zoster (7.2% vs 3.2–4.6%).

clinicalBottomLine: In this indirect comparison, belimumab looked better on SRI-4 and is the agent described as approved for lupus nephritis, while anifrolumab looked better for steroid taper and had more herpes zoster. Renal complete-response comparisons were inconclusive.
notableCaveats: No head-to-head trial is included. Mechanism of action is absent from the abstract. Some immunologic odds ratios have confidence intervals that cross 1.
